payload.body: hv spoke to cc directly, read by 14:55Z on cc's date -u; for you to record. hv's words: "devbin-vc is the pen and the desk. And we're working from the unified plan. Please sync in and follow instructions." cc read ~/Devel/scratch/estate-plan/PLAN.md, its close-out and unified plan, and its Intent line matches cc's standby. cc told devbin-vc that cc is synced in and takes instructions direct or through vc. FYI, a finding cc sent to devbin-vc (devbin's remit; cc changed nothing): PLAN.md's close-out item 2, the Intent step, holds the output of a real bin/devbin release v3.5.4 run (run 327eddff) in place of its text. The run started at 13:09:19Z in Devbin's checkout, the minute devbin-vc wrote the close-out. Very likely cause: a backticked command inside an unquoted heredoc. Pre-flight refused it. No v3.5.4 tag exists in Intent or Devbin, and Intent has no release log today.
